'''Mawvorr''' were a hostile, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] group of [[Species/Legends|species]] found throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. The group included [[crysfang]]s, native to [[Voss]], [[felshade]]s, also known as bog mawvorrs, native to [[Zakuul]] and [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], and multiple subspecies of [[mewvorr]], which were smaller in size and often kept as pets during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

Mawvorr were four-legged, typically carnivorous<ref name="codex" /> creatures. They had distinctive four-eyed heads with multiple rows of teeth, high nostrils, two spiky appendages on the both sides and, with an exception of Stunning mawvorrs, two big plates, in addition to four on their backs. The plates of several mawvorr species were glowing, revealing the vessels inside; such were called chromatophore plates. All limbs of a mawvorr had three digits ending with big claws, and their tails and bellies were covered in plates.<ref name="TOR" />
